title: 273. Big problems for Big pharma
summary_md:
# 273. Big problems for Big pharma

**Feed**: aktiepodden  
**Published**: 2026-09-18  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Episode 273 opens with a US Fed rate hike (first in 1148 days) read as the central bank asserting independence from political pressure, with markets pricing further hikes into 2026-2027 — a headwind for growth and capital-intensive stocks. The core theme is trouble for Big Pharma: MFN/tariff-driven investment shifting from Europe to the US, a looming wave of patent expiries (over $400bn in 2028-2032) and rising, less productive R&D costs, leading the hosts to favour smaller, nimbler drug names over mega-caps. Case ideas skew positive on quality small/mid-caps — Epiroc, Ambea, FM Mattsson — with BHG (Bygghemma) highlighted as the week's outright buy on a recovering consumer, improving margins and a cheap ~8x EV/EBIT valuation.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 BHG — BHG (Bygghemma Group) | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Positiv lönsamhetstrend efter omstrukturering, kontrollerad nettoskuld, låg värdering ~8x EV/EBIT 2027, insynsköp och förbättrad makrobild för hushållen.

#### Reasoning

After a horrible 2023-24 restructuring, BHG reached a 3.7% operating margin in 2025 with 2026 looking better. Short-term margin target 5%, medium-term 7%. Net debt under control; cutting the ~SEK100m of SEK300m EBIT going to interest would boost profit. At ~8x forward 2027 EV/EBIT with decent organic growth and improving consumer confidence, the host calls it a buy. Insiders have bought over the past six months.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the consumer/housing recovery stalls in 2027
- if operating margin fails to progress toward 5%
- if net debt cannot be reduced further
- if organic growth turns negative

> *"Jag tycker faktiskt att det är köpläge."*

---

### 🟢 EPI-B — Epiroc | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Fortsatt stark utveckling väntas: gröna skott i bygg kan lyfta marginal, högt guldpris med utbudsunderskott, och skydd mot kinesisk konkurrens pga lågvolymsproduktion.

#### Reasoning

Presented at Aktiedagarna, Epiroc's strong run looks set to continue. ~20% of order book is construction where green shoots could lift margins that lagged Sandvik. Gold (a third of mining orders, ~80% of business) expected to stay high on supply deficit and central-bank buying. Low-volume, complex machines shield it from Chinese high-volume competition.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the gold price falls sharply
- if construction recovery fails to materialise
- if Chinese competitors move into low-volume heavy machinery
- if global mining capex slows

> *"Mycket ser ut att tala för Epiroc även framåt."*

---

### 🟢 AMBEA — Ambea | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Pipeline av vårdplatser +64% på årsbasis, ~2,7 mdr kr extra omsättning till 2030; lirar väl med konsensus vilket ger prognosstöd och skydd på nedsidan.

#### Reasoning

Ambea's care-bed pipeline grows 64% y/y, adding ~SEK2.7bn revenue to 2030 (weighted to 2028). This matches consensus, so it is a downside protection / forecast support rather than a fresh trigger. Higher build-out and the Humana assistance inclusion pressure margins near-term, but management targets a return to ~9.5% margin by end-2028 — seen as unstretched in the Ambea/Attendo duopoly, with scale upside.

#### Sell Triggers

- if new-bed occupancy ramps slower than expected
- if the 9.5% margin target is not reached by end-2028
- if Humana synergies fail to realise
- if political/regulatory changes hit private care

> *"Det finns lite substans i förväntningarna kan man sammanfatta det som."*

---

### 🟢 FMM-B — FM Mattsson | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

+50% på tre månader och krossar index; slår organisk tillväxtmål fem kvartal i rad, förvärvet av marknadsledande Bristan förbättrar marginalmix; momentum kan ge mer.

#### Reasoning

New CEO highlights beating the ~5% organic growth ambition five quarters running, giving positive margin effects. The June acquisition of UK market leader Bristan (taps) — echoing Svedbergs' success with Roper — lifts the direct-to-consumer share and margin mix. Despite +50% in three months, in a momentum market where winners keep winning the host sees potentially more to give.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth drops below the 5% target
- if the Bristan integration disappoints
- if UK market weakens as it did for Nobia
- if consumer/durables demand rolls over

> *"FM Mattsson trots den här fantastiska kursuppgången kanske har lite mer att ge."*

---

### 🟢 SOBI — Sobi | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Tesen är att undvika big pharma och leta bland mindre nischade bolag; Sobi har tydlig M&A-strategi och kan addera preparat utöver egen pipeline.

#### Reasoning

The pharma thesis is to avoid big pharma (exposed to patent cliffs, MFN pricing, rising R&D costs) and favour smaller, focused names. Sobi is highlighted as a clearly niched smaller player with an active M&A strategy — buying in preparations rather than relying solely on in-house pipeline — which matters more for it than for a giant like Pfizer. Rising value of late-stage research assets could also help.

#### Sell Triggers

- if key acquired preparations underperform
- if MFN/pricing pressure spreads beyond big pharma
- if late-stage assets it targets inflate too much in price

> *"Så det tycker jag är taken här, att satsa på lite mindre läkemedelsbolag."*

---

### 🟡 AZN — AstraZeneca | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Robust pipeline vs peers motiverar högre värdering, men studiemiss (-9%), BMS-fusionsrykten och branschens patentklippa skapar osäkerhet; hosten manar undvika big pharma generellt.

#### Reasoning

Astra has historically enjoyed a premium for a more robust late-stage pipeline relative to peers' patent expiries (ex-Eli Lilly). But a summer trial miss knocked the stock 9% — more than the drug's value — and BMS merger speculation weighed, showing sensitivity to any pipeline weakness. Against the backdrop of a huge industry patent cliff and the hosts' 'avoid big pharma' stance, it is not a conviction buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if further trial read-outs disappoint
- if a value-destroying BMS-style merger proceeds
- if pipeline fails to offset patent expiries
- if MFN pricing erodes US revenue more than expected

> *"undvik big pharma, alltså de största läkemedelsbolagen är exponerade mot väldigt tuffa trender"*
